rollback: Only meaningful if r.wecare.digital is ever un-retired, which the owner decision of 2026-09-28 (confirmation YES R53-DELETE-001) forbids. If it were: request a fresh ACM certificate for r.wecare.digital with DNS validation, which mints a NEW validation name and value. Re-creating THIS record would not validate a new certificate, because the validation token is per-certificate. The literal restore, if wanted verbatim, is route53 change-resource-record-sets with Action=CREATE and the deletedRecord block above.
